description: Identify the brand, model family and exact model of a firearm from a title or a short description (e.g. 'G19 Gen5 MOS', 'Sig P365 XL', 'S&W M&P Shield Plus'). Covers 50 brands including Glock, Sig Sauer, Smith & Wesson, Ruger, Springfield, Beretta, Taurus, Mossberg, Remington, Savage and Henry. Glock part numbers (e.g. PA195S203) are decoded too. Returns GunsNPrices pages for the model, its family and the brand.
name: identify_firearm_model
title: Identify a firearm model
